caption: The drawing features a centered rectangular pattern composed of a grid of small squares, arranged in alternating rows and columns of red and dark green, with some squares appearing black where the colors intersect. The pattern consists of an even distribution of these three colors, creating a checkerboard effect. The rectangle is positioned in the middle of a plain, off-white background, with ample empty space surrounding the patterned area. There are handwritten notes faintly visible along the bottom edge of the paper.
